description: Coordinate owner-private helper conversations using configured agents, attributed task messages, child observations, stop controls, durable reminders, explicit handoff, saved helper promotion and System-role prompt proposals.

levels.conservative: DELEGATION POSTURE — Conservative: strongly prefer doing the work yourself in this session. Only spawn a helper when the task genuinely cannot proceed without one (e.g. truly independent parallel work, or a sub-job that needs an ability you'd rather not run inline). Default to NOT spawning.
levels.eager: DELEGATION POSTURE — Eager: delegation is your DEFAULT working style — doing the whole job yourself is the exception you have to justify. Before you build or write anything, STOP and break the task into separable units, then spawn a purpose-built helper for EACH unit (forked for units that can run in parallel, blocking for a sequential chain). Keep a piece for yourself only when it genuinely cannot be handed off — e.g. it shares tight, inseparable state with everything else. Do not quietly fall back to doing it all yourself because it feels easier. When in doubt, spawn.

settings.label: Delegation
settings.hint: How readily this agent hands work to spawned helpers. Conservative = only spawn when truly necessary; Balanced = today's judgment; Eager = default to splitting separable work across helpers. This rides along as a posture note in the agent's prompt — it nudges the decision, it is not a hard rule.

settings.label: Max Concurrent Spawns
settings.hint: Maximum active user-task helpers for one working agent. Pending, queued, and running helpers count; terminal helpers immediately free a slot. Manager and contract reviewers use separate internal capacity.

settings.label: Max Spawns per Spawn
settings.hint: How many sub-helpers a spawned clone is allowed to create. This governs recursion breadth at each level. Set to 0 to forbid spawned clones from spawning anything (even if they have the orchestration ability — the main agent can still spawn normally). The default of 1 means each clone makes at most one helper of its own.

settings.label: Max Spawn Depth
settings.hint: How many levels of spawns-within-spawns are allowed. 0 means only the main orchestrator can spawn (all clones are leaf workers, even those given the orchestration ability). 1 lets the main agent's direct spawns also spawn one more level. 2 allows two levels of nesting, and so on. The main agent is level 0; each spawn increments the depth by 1.

migration_note: Native V3 implementation. Current schemas, live policy and configured model/module availability determine callable behavior.
